# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series; dies at sixty-three.
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Matthew is an awkwardly built man with stooped shoulders and dark hair turning gray. He wears a full, soft brown beard that he has grown since his early twenties. He typically dresses in plain, quiet clothes suited for working on his farm.

## Personality

Extremely shy and reclusive, Matthew is uncomfortable in the company of women and strangers, preferring to keep to himself. Despite his shyness, he possesses a deeply gentle, kind, and compassionate heart. He is a quiet observer who expresses his love through quiet acts of generosity and unwavering support. He understands Anne's imaginative spirit better than almost anyone else from the moment they meet.

## Traits

- Painfully shy around women
- Gentle and soft-spoken
- Generous and indulgent
- Fear of public speaking and social attention

## Abilities

- Farming and animal care
- Quietly listening and comforting others

## Goals

- To give Anne a happy, loving home and support her dreams
- To maintain Green Gables alongside his sister Marilla

## History

Matthew and his sister Marilla decide to adopt an orphan boy to help Matthew with the farm work as his health begins to fail. When Matthew travels to the Bright River station, he finds that an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley, was sent by mistake. Enchanted by her bright chatter and spirit during the ride home, Matthew immediately wants to keep her. He quietly persuades Marilla to let Anne stay at Green Gables, becoming her constant champion and confidant. Over the next few years, Matthew indulges Anne, famously buying her a dress with puff sleeves when he notices she feels different from other girls. When Anne earns a scholarship to Queen's Academy and excels in her studies, Matthew takes immense pride in her accomplishments. Shortly after Anne completes her studies at Queen's and returns home, Matthew suffers a sudden, fatal heart attack upon reading that the Abbey Bank, where his savings were kept, has failed. His death deeply mourned by Anne, Marilla, and the entire Avonlea community.

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Green Gables with his sister Marilla
- Remained unmarried and stayed on the family farm his entire life
- Grew his beard at age twenty-two mainly due to his shyness

## Affiliations

- Cuthbert Family — Head of household and co-owner of Green Gables

## Relationships

### Anne Shirley

- Parent of — Adoptive father figure who dotes on and deeply understands her.

### Marilla Cuthbert

- Sibling of — Older sister with whom he shared Green Gables and raised Anne.

### Rachel Lynde

- Friend of — Longtime neighbor, though Matthew remains intimidated by her talkative nature.
